reason: The core holds; three parts do not. The 10:16Z plan the user accepted (3 night + 2 morning) names 'the strongest knob arm on the best base', and the best base is now the CI file exp79a. Amendment A (09:35Z) already uses the 'arms off the current best' logic. No arm has been scored, so this is a legal pre-score amendment under R1-R10. The gate is honest and fail-soft. DOES NOT HOLD: (a) The R+ branch (exp89c/d on exp87a) breaks W4 AMEND 3 (1)-1, 'stack depth capped at cap + 2 levers'. exp87a is already cap + K + CI, so an arm on it is 3 levers. Its base read (probe 51) also lands only ~22:00-23:30Z, too late to push and queue a dummy before the 23:30Z freeze. (b) 'Push by ~20:30Z' conflicts with the 3-4 h CI dummy queues seen on 27 Sep and the 23:30Z PASSED-dummy deadline. (c) Building and dummying two arms (TAU and DIS) spends ~1.1 of the ~4.5-4.8 GPU-h left for one slot. The quota cannot be re-read now: Chrome has been disconnected since 06:35Z and the API has no quota call. (d) 'Its + comes too late for a CI stack' is only half true. A 00:05Z non-CI read lands ~07:05-07:55Z and could feed a CI stack by ~09:00Z, but only if the user says yes to morning CI. So TAU is not the 'strongest arm'; DIS is the better pick (ranked first, prior medium). If the CI arm wins, both finals could carry CI unless a non-CI twin is kept as the hedge (PC25-06).

(2) Add (r'exp89[a-z]*', 'safetail_ci') above exp8\d in tools/runtime_ledger.py with a test, and start the -m with 'probe N: exp89a = ...'. (3) Push the dummy at probe 50's terminal header (~12:00-13:00Z), not 20:30Z. Hard latest push 19:00Z; after that the slot falls back to exp88a/exp88c non-CI. (4) Pre-register the gate before reading the output: validate ok; 0 Traceback/FAILED/DEADLINE:/FALLING BACK; COORDINJECT 4/4, replaced >= 0.90; topology columns identical to the matching non-CI dummy (exp88a 482dbda1d1a0, or exp88c's CSV); integer-coordinate change 0.60-0.69; runtime rule v2 with the parent = CI sibling exp79a 1,712 s (x1.15 = 1,969 s). (5) Log it as W4 AMEND 4's third night file at 00:45Z or 01:25Z (a CI read by ~11:15Z), after E10 and the FULL/best stack. Keep the non-CI twin as a morning file only if a slot is free after the FULL twin. On the finals card, pair any CI winner with a non-CI file (exp70g, or the twin if it reads).
